Engage Patients,
Improve Outcomes.

I partner with organizations, individuals, and care providers to foster patient self-advocacy and build patient-centered systems.

Learn more

Patient engagement and self-advocacy can reshape care.

The healthcare system makes little room for self-advocating, engaged patients. But systems where patients truly share in decision-making report better outcomes and improved patient wellbeing.

SERVICES

Building a future where engaged patients are the norm in responsive, inclusive, and relentlessly patient-focused systems.

  • Integrating a patient-centered mindset, patient participation barrier comprehension, and patient advocacy into medical and nursing school curricula.

    • Guest Lectures & Patient Panels

    • Curriculum Development

    • Student Workshop

  • Co-creating and implementing strategies that promote patient-centered care and self-advocacy.

    • Guest Lectures and Patient Panels

    • Training Programs

    • Cultural Transformation Workshops

    • Quality Improvement Projects

  • Ensuring your end product aligns with consumer needs by building patient engagement into design and research.

    • Coordinating productive patient advisory panels and focus groups

    • Designing high-impact support resources that improve patient satisfaction

    • Training professionals in health care self-advocacy principles
